meta.name: game-art-direction
meta.description: Direct game art and creative vision. Turn GAME_DESIGN into a production-level ART_DIRECTION defining a recognizable visual style, camera and composition, world and character grammar, functional colour/light/material, HUD feedback, motion and transition specs, audio direction, and a signature moment for every screen and mode. Use for what should the game look like, set the art direction, define the visual style. 游戏美术与创意方向。把 GAME_DESIGN 转成策划级 ART_DIRECTION，定义可辨识视觉风格、镜头构图、世界与角色语法、功能性色光材质、界面反馈、运动与转场规格、声音方向和每个界面/模式的签名游戏时刻。用于判断游戏应该长什么样、制定游戏美术方向等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把游戏故事变成可执行的美术方向蓝图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正在做游戏,想统一团队的美术风格
copy.tagline_en: Turn game narratives into an actionable art direction blueprint
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're making a game and want to align your team's art style

howto.what: 把 GAME_DESIGN 转成 ART_DIRECTION.md，并生成 VISUAL_TARGETS.md 与 visual-targets/：定义画风、镜头构图、角色语法、功能色光、界面反馈、运动转场、声音方向、各屏签名时刻，附覆盖表；targetFinish 逐字继承 PRODUCT_BRIEF。
howto.when: 当你说“游戏应该长什么样”“制定美术方向”“定义视觉风格”等需求时触发；前提是已有批准的 GAME_DESIGN.md 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF.md。

say.text: 为这个游戏定义视觉风格：镜头、角色语法、色光材质与界面反馈。
say.note: 产出相关章节和覆盖表。

say.text: 按发布门禁生成视觉目标包，含三类视图与失败例。
say.note: 输出 VISUAL_TARGETS.md 和持久目录。

howto.what_en: Reads GAME_DESIGN.md and the method file; writes ART_DIRECTION.md, VISUAL_TARGETS.md and visual-targets/. Defines style, camera, grammar, functional color/light/material, HUD, motion/transitions, audio, signature moments, plus a coverage table; targetFinish inherits PRODUCT_BRIEF.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests like “what should the game look like”, “set the art direction”, or “define the visual style”. Requires an approved GAME_DESIGN.md and PRODUCT_BRIEF.md.

say_en.text: Turn GAME_DESIGN.md into an art direction doc and output ART_DIRECTION.md.
Define the visual style: camera, character grammar, color/light/material, HUD feedback.
say_en.note: Outputs the relevant sections and coverage table.

say_en.text: Generate the visual target package by release gate, with three view types and failure examples.
say_en.note: Outputs VISUAL_TARGETS.md and the persistent directory.
